description: A vulnerability in NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source when configured with the ngx_stream_ssl_preread_module allows an unauthenticated attacker to send a specially crafted ClientHello message that forges module variable values. This can affect virtual server selection and potentially cause routing to privileged or internal backends that should be inaccessible. The issue is limited to the data plane and does not expose the control plane.
